question: Ravikirti was a court poet of which Chalukya ruler?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** ****Prashasti** is an** Indian genre **of** inscriptions **composed by **poets **in **praise of their rulers.**
 
• The best-known **Chalukyan** king was **Pulakeshin II**.
 
• We come to know about him from a **prashasti **composed by his **court poet, Ravikirt**i.
 
• According to** Ravikirti,** **Pulakeshin II** led expeditions along both the** west** and the** east coasts**.
 
• **Pulakeshin **also attacked the** Pallava king **who took shelter behind the walls of **Kanchipuram**.
 
• Thus, we can say that **Prashasti of Pulakeshin II** was composed by his **court poet**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vikramaditya II :

 
 
• **Vikramaditya II** was the son of Vengi Chalukya king Vijayaditya and heir to the throne.
 
• **Vikramaditya II **kept the **power of the Chalukya Empire** intact during his time.
 
 
 
• **Kirtivarman II **- 
 
 
• **Kirtivarman II **also known as **Rahappa** was the** last ruler** in the **Badami Chalukya dynasty**. 
 
• He succeeded his father** Vikramaditya II**.
